title: Vela incident labeled the '747 incident'

tellings.quote:
>> It's it's called uh the seven they
labeled it as the 747 incident.

plain: The Vela incident, a mysterious flash picked up over the South Atlantic in 1979 and linked to South Africa or Israel, was privately labelled the '747 incident', according to a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen. He tells Michels he heard the name from a scientist at the Department of Energy whom he does not name. The label suggests insiders treated the event as something other than the official account.
